items.title: Jonathan Kuminga spent most of his career among the league's more ball-dominant players: 75th–88th percentile in On Ball %. With the Wolves he's at 8.0%, 9th percentile. Early sample, but that's a real shift in how he plays.
items.author: Hoop Informatics
items.body_excerpt:
Jonathan Kuminga spent most of his career among the league's more ball-dominant players: 75th–88th percentile in On Ball %. With the Wolves he's at 8.0%, 9th percentile. Early sample, but that's a real shift in how he plays.

On Ball %: Share of offensive time player is holding or dribbling the ball

images.alt:
Column chart titled "Jonathan Kuminga On Ball %," with the subtitle "Share of offensive time player is holding or dribbling the ball." Six bars show each season's On Ball % with its league percentile, colored by team with the team logo inside.

2022, Golden State Warriors: 12.6%, 75th percentile
2023, Golden State Warriors: 13.1%, 81st percentile
2024, Golden State Warriors: 16.0%, 85th percentile
2025, Golden State Warriors: 20.4%, 88th percentile
2026, split diagonally between the Golden State Warriors and Atlanta Hawks: 18.8%, 79th percentile
2027, Minnesota Timberwolves: 8.0%, 9th percentile

His On Ball % rose each season through 2025, dipped slightly in 2026, then fell sharply to 8.0% in 2027. A footnote says the 2027 season is in progress. Data: DataballR. Viz: @Hoopinformatics.com on Bluesky.
